- [RCTS.1.2.3] **`category`** — the name of the directory the fixture is
  in ([RCTS.1.1.4]). A harness must fail a fixture whose `category` is any
  other string ([RCTS.1.2.15]), and every fixture in a directory under
  `specs/conformance/` that is not a category of [RCTS.1.1.4], the harness's
  own directory excepted. It must not report either as skipped.
